invariants: The audio generation path must use FPGA HDL only.
No MCU, CPU, PC software, or BL702 in the sample-by-sample path.
No recorded PCM or full-song playback.
Only one-cycle mathematical wavetables may be stored.
Do not expand to 32 voices before the four-voice baseline passes.
Use SRAM Program operation 2; do not use Program and Verify.
